subject: Network gatekeeper & service identity binding — preflight playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Network gatekeeper & service identity binding — preflight playbook

Alex — quick preflight before our implementation sprint next week. High-level asks so we can unblock the eng rollout: 

1) IP allowlist: you mentioned a /20 public range and a couple of dynamic ranges for dev. Can you confirm the final prefixes so we can populate the prefix list and firewall change ticket?

2) Service accounts: we'll require two delegated service identities for runtime telemetry and provisioning (one short-lived canary SA + one long-lived provisioning SA). We prefer names that map to your IAM taxonomy; example: bp-redwood-provisioning and bp-redwood-canary. Can your SRE confirm acceptance?

3) SSO/SAML & SCIM: we have a SCIM provisioning connector ready, but our canonical attribute mapping needs: email, uid, displayName, department. Any custom attributes we should add? Also need IdP metadata (entityID and ACS URL) for the SAML setup.

4) Org policy constraints: are there constraints on cross-account role assumption we should avoid (e.g., disallow external principals)? If so, call them out now so we can propose a guarded service account delegation flow.

Attached is our implementation checklist and a sample IP prefixes CSV to edit. If you can send the small confirmations above by EOD Monday, Monica will stage the configuration and Ben will schedule the dry-run.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BluePeak Health - Security Team <security@bluepeakhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Network gatekeeper & service identity binding — preflight playbook

Tessa — thanks for the checklist, looks good. Quick answers inline:

1) IP prefixes: final public prefix is 198.51.100.0/22; dev/beta ranges are 203.0.113.0/24 and 203.0.114.0/24 (these are NATed). I'll attach a sanitized list.

2) Service accounts: SRE ok with bp-redwood-provisioning and bp-redwood-canary. We prefer the provisioning SA to be tied to a short-lived key rotation policy (30 days). Can Redwood’s runtime support that?

3) SCIM attributes: email, uid, displayName are fine. We also need an attribute 'employeeId' for onboarding reports. SAML metadata attached (entityID + ACS).

4) Org policy: we disallow external principal role assumptions for production. For the provisioning path we'll need a cross-account pattern that uses an internal bastion role — I'll send the policy snippet.

I'll upload the sanitized IP CSV and the policy snippet to the shared Drive link in a few minutes.

—Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Platform Engineering, BluePeak Health
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Network gatekeeper & service identity binding — preflight playbook

Alex — thank you, uploaded the edited CSV and the SCIM attribute mapping we will use. Notes and next steps: 

- IP allowlist: accepted 198.51.100.0/22 for prod and the two NATed dev prefixes. Ben will open the firewall change ticket on Tuesday (target window: Thu 5/6 02:00–04:00 PDT).

- Short-lived keys: Redwood runtime supports short-lived service credentials via our rotating key manager — we can enforce 30d rotation and require the provisioning SA to be bound to a token-exchange flow. I'll include the sample IAM policy we recommend in the Drive.

- SCIM: added employeeId as an additional attribute. We will map SCIM 'externalId' -> employeeId in your IdP. Please confirm the attribute name in your IdP (Alex said 'employeeId' above).

- SAML metadata: received and validated. Tessa — we still need the ACS URL for the customer-facing callback (I'll put placeholder if not provided).

Attachments in Drive: redwood-impl-checklist.pdf, bp-ip-allowlist-prefixes.csv, scim-mapping-20270502.json (policy snippet and sample IAM role included).

Action items assigned: 
- Alex: confirm IdP 'employeeId' attribute name and approve firewall change window (due 5/03 EOD).
- Ben: schedule dry-run and send invite to BluePeak SRE (target 5/05).
- Tessa: validate audit log retention and key escrow requirements with Legal if needed.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Network gatekeeper & service identity binding — preflight playbook

Alex — invite sent for the dry-run on 2027-05-05 09:00 PT (calendar invite includes runbook link). We'll do a coordinated test: SCIM provisioning of 5 test users, SAML login check, and an IP-blocked vs allowed traffic test using the canary SA. Expected duration ~60 minutes. Please add your SRE and one app owner to the invite.

If anything changes on the firewall window, post to the invite thread and we'll adapt.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
